commands.review_summary:
Adds an embedded-run helper that aborts critical blocked tool-loop results across direct-tool and Tool Search execution paths, with focused helper tests.

PR surface: Source +45, Tests +88. Total +133 across 3 files.

Reproducibility: yes. at source level: a critical blocked tool result is returned without terminate metadata, and current agent-core continues unless the batch terminates or shouldStopAfterTurn stops it. The linked release incident supplies matching repeated-block logs, but this review did not establish a live current-main run.
commands.review_followup: - [P1] A maintainer should select the canonical agent-core termination implementation between the two open candidate PRs after the code defect and real-proof gate are resolved; opening another automated fix would duplicate active work.

target.title: fix(agents): terminate agent run on critical loop detection instead of continuing indefinitely
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Critical loop detection correctly blocks a stuck tool (`deniedReason: "tool-loop"`), but the blocked result was returned to the model as an ordinary tool result. The agent kept issuing provider turns and re-calling the same tool for hours (#106231).

## Why This Change Was Made

Abort the embedded attempt at the run owner boundary when a tool result is a critical tool-loop block. One typed helper owns the contract; direct-tool wraps, Tool Search hydration wraps, and Tool Search target execution all call it.

## User Impact

- Critical tool loops terminate the run instead of burning resources indefinitely.
- Non-loop blocks (plugin/approval vetoes) are unchanged.
- Operators see a terminated run rather than a zombie session after `action=block` at critical level.

## Evidence

**Head SHA:** `c46f9dc8dfcec464c5d92df79b76d0b8ce034e4f` (rebased onto current `main`)

### Rank-up coverage

| Rank-up | Status |
|---|---|
| Rebase onto current main | done |
| One typed critical-loop termination helper | `critical-tool-loop-abort.ts` |
| Invoke from direct-tool + Tool Search paths | 3 call sites in `attempt.ts` |
| Focused regression for both paths | 4 tests in `critical-tool-loop-abort.test.ts` |
| No subsequent provider turn after critical block | unit loop transcript below (`provider-turn` then `abort` only) |

### Patch shape

- 3 files: helper + test + `attempt.ts` wiring (~+10 on attempt; helper/tests focused)
- No speculative public exports beyond the run-local helper
- Explicit contract: `status === "blocked" && deniedReason === "tool-loop"` (not bare string heuristic)

### L1 / whole-path helper proof (production helper on the call chain)

```text
$ node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/run/critical-tool-loop-abort.test.ts --reporter=verbose

✓ |agents| src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/run/critical-tool-loop-abort.test.ts > critical tool-loop abort helper > recognizes only blocked tool-loop results 76ms
 ✓ |agents| src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/run/critical-tool-loop-abort.test.ts > critical tool-loop abort helper > aborts for a direct-tool critical loop and leaves no room for a follow-up provider turn 5ms
 ✓ |agents| src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/run/critical-tool-loop-abort.test.ts > critical tool-loop abort helper > aborts for a Tool Search hydrated-tool critical loop the same way 1ms
 ✓ |agents| src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/run/critical-tool-loop-abort.test.ts > critical tool-loop abort helper > does not abort when abortRun is not wired yet or result is not a tool-loop block 1ms
 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  4 passed (4)
   Duration  583ms (transform 351ms, setup 266ms, import 34ms, tests 87ms, environment 0ms)
```

Direct-tool and Tool Search simulated agent loops both emit exactly:
`["provider-turn", "abort"]` — no second provider turn after the critical block.

### Before / after

| Case | BEFORE | AFTER |
|---|---|---|
| Critical `tool-loop` block on direct tool | result returned; model continues | `abortRun(false, Error(...))`; run terminates |
| Critical `tool-loop` on Tool Search hydrated tool | same zombie loop | same abort via `captureAbortRun` |
| Other blocked reasons | unchanged | unchanged (helper ignores non-`tool-loop`) |

### Issue evidence (shipped incident)

From #106231: critical block at `count=10` / `action=block`, then block messages every 5–30s for ~2.8h with continued model/tool activity. This PR targets that terminal behavior.

### Files

- `src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/run/critical-tool-loop-abort.ts`
- `src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/run/critical-tool-loop-abort.test.ts`
- `src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/run/attempt.ts`

Fixes #106231

## Agent Transcript

- Cursor session: Rank-up for critical tool-loop abort helper + dual-path coverage.

Made with [Cursor](https://cursor.com)
